original_snippet:
if key in self._cache:
            return self._cache[key]
description: Remove the cache-hit short-circuit so a replayed key re-executes the handler
expected_violation: Replaying an existing idempotency key re-executes the handler instead of returning the cached response
violation_scenario: Calling execute_or_replay('k1', handler) twice invokes handler twice instead of once, returning a freshly computed value on replay.
rationale: Deleting the two cache-hit lines is the smallest plausible change that makes a replayed request re-execute the handler.
